description: Seven regulating reservoirs of the Jiaodong water-transfer project have satellite-derived water-colour records covering 1990–2022. The China Institute of Water Resources and Hydropower Research and Shandong operations centre use Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery to calculate Forel-Ule Index values. ScienceDB provides GeoTIFF rasters and an XLSX resource under CC BY-NC 4.0 for free non-commercial reuse. Pixel values and coordinates can support reservoir water-quality and operational-context simulations. Water colour is a proxy, not a direct concentration measurement, and cloud cover, sensors and retrieval assumptions may limit consistency over time. The collection does not supply reservoir release rules or hydraulic capacities. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: A spatial-temporal variation dataset of water color of regulating reservoirs for water transfer project during 1990-2022
